text: Under diffuse (pervasive) competition, confident retrieval collapses well before length limits.
The tool block sits at the front of the cached prefix; mutating it invalidates the whole suffix (measured ~7x a stable prefix).
Stale tool_use references in history confuse the model when the current tools list disagrees (the coherence leg — literature-only, untested here).
A carry-vs-swap tool-set break-even exists, KV-cache-governed: carry-cost is linear in superset size, swap-cost flat; below N* carry is cheaper, above it swap wins despite busting the cache.

Under diffuse competition, as capability rises the failure mode shifts from confident confabulation toward honest refusal and the knee moves EARLIER (consistent with conflict-detection OR refusal-affordance-following — undecided).
In the PARAMETRIC knowledge-gap regime, larger / instruction-tuned models hallucinate MORE and abstain LESS — the opposite scaling.
